entries.title: Psalms 89:1
segments: ¶<Maschil. Of Ethan the Ezrahite.> My song will be of the mercies of the Lord for ever: with my mouth will I make his faith clear to all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 89:2
segments: For you have said, Mercy will be made strong for ever; my faith will be unchanging in the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 89:3
segments: I have made an agreement with the man of my selection, I have made an oath to David my servant;

entries.title: Psalms 89:4
segments: I will make your seed go on for ever, your kingdom will be strong through all generations. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 89:5
segments: ¶In heaven let them give praise for your wonders, O Lord; and your unchanging faith among the saints.

entries.title: Psalms 89:6
segments: For who is there in the heavens in comparison with the Lord? who is like the Lord among the sons of the gods?

entries.title: Psalms 89:7
segments: God is greatly to be feared among the saints, and to be honoured over all those who are about him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:8
segments: O Lord God of armies, who is strong like you, O Jah? and your unchanging faith is round about you.

entries.title: Psalms 89:9
segments: You have rule over the sea in storm; when its waves are troubled, you make them calm.

entries.title: Psalms 89:10
segments: Rahab was crushed by you like one wounded to death; with your strong arm you put to flight all your haters.

entries.title: Psalms 89:11
segments: Yours are the heavens, and the earth is yours; you have made the world, and everything which is in it.

entries.title: Psalms 89:12
segments: You have made the north and the south; Tabor and Hermon are sounding with joy at your name.

entries.title: Psalms 89:13
segments: Yours is an arm of power; strong is your hand and high your right hand.

entries.title: Psalms 89:14
segments: The seat of your kingdom is resting on righteousness and right judging: mercy and good faith come before your face.

entries.title: Psalms 89:15
segments: ¶Happy are the people who have knowledge of the holy cry: the light of your face, O Lord, will be shining on their way.

entries.title: Psalms 89:16
segments: In your name will they have joy all the day: in your righteousness will they be lifted up.

entries.title: Psalms 89:17
segments: For you are the glory of their strength; in your pleasure will our horn be lifted up.

entries.title: Psalms 89:18
segments: For our breastplate is the Lord; and our king is the Holy One of Israel's.

entries.title: Psalms 89:19
segments: ¶Then your voice came to your holy one in a vision, saying, I have put the crown on a strong one, lifting up one taken from among the people.

entries.title: Psalms 89:20
segments: I have made discovery of David my servant; I have put my holy oil on his head.

entries.title: Psalms 89:21
segments: My hand will be his support; my arm will give him strength.

entries.title: Psalms 89:22
segments: The deceit of those who are against him will not overcome him; he will not be troubled by the sons of evil.

entries.title: Psalms 89:23
segments: I will have those who are against him broken before his face, and his haters will be crushed under my blows.

entries.title: Psalms 89:24
segments: But my faith and my mercy will be with him; and in my name will his horn be lifted up.

entries.title: Psalms 89:25
segments: I will put his hand in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

entries.title: Psalms 89:26
segments: He will say to me, You are my father, my God, and the Rock of my salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 89:27
segments: And I will make him the first of my sons, most high over the kings of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 89:28
segments: I will keep my mercy for him for ever; my agreement with him will not be changed.

entries.title: Psalms 89:29
segments: His seed will keep their place for ever; his kingdom will be eternal, like the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 89:30
segments: If his children give up my law, and are not ruled by my decisions;

entries.title: Psalms 89:31
segments: If my rules are broken, and my orders are not kept;

entries.title: Psalms 89:32
segments: Then I will send punishment on them for their sin; my rod will be the reward of their evil-doing.

entries.title: Psalms 89:33
segments: But I will not take away my mercy from him, and will not be false to my faith.

entries.title: Psalms 89:34
segments: I will be true to my agreement; the things which have gone out of my lips will not be changed.

entries.title: Psalms 89:35
segments: I have made an oath once by my holy name, that I will not be false to David.

entries.title: Psalms 89:36
segments: His seed will not come to an end for ever; the seat of his kingdom will be like the sun before me.

entries.title: Psalms 89:37
segments: It will be fixed for ever like the moon; and the witness in heaven is true. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 89:38
segments: ¶But you have put him away in disgust; you have been angry with the king of your selection.

entries.title: Psalms 89:39
segments: You have made your agreement with your servant of no effect: you have had no respect for his crown, it has come down even to the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 89:40
segments: All his walls are broken down; you have given his strong towers to destruction.

entries.title: Psalms 89:41
segments: All those who come by take away his goods; he is laughed at by his neighbours.

entries.title: Psalms 89:42
segments: You have given power to the right hand of his haters; you have made glad all those who are against him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:43
segments: His sword is turned back; you have not been his support in the fight.

entries.title: Psalms 89:44
segments: You have put an end to his glory: the seat of his kingdom has been levelled to the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 89:45
segments: You have made him old before his time; he is covered with shame. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 89:46
segments: How long, O Lord, will you Keep yourself for ever from our eyes? how long will your wrath be burning like fire?

entries.title: Psalms 89:47
segments: See how short my time is; why have you made all men for no purpose?

entries.title: Psalms 89:48
segments: What man now living will not see death? will he be able to keep back his soul from the underworld? (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 89:49
segments: Lord, where are your earlier mercies? where is the oath which you made to David in unchanging faith?

entries.title: Psalms 89:50
segments: Keep in mind, O Lord, the shame of your servants, and how the bitter words of all the people have come into my heart;

entries.title: Psalms 89:51
segments: The bitter words of your haters, O Lord, shaming the footsteps of your king.

entries.title: Psalms 89:52
segments: Let the Lord be praised for ever. So be it, So be it.
